description: Registry of every numerical or label claim quoted in the manuscript and supplement (package version 1.1.0, two prospective studies). scripts/check_statistics.py recomputes each derivation from the saved source records, compares it with the literal, confirms the literal appears in each named document, and fails on any decimal with three or more places or comma-grouped integer in the documents that is not registered here. Rounding is ROUND_HALF_UP on exact rational values; interval endpoints and half-widths are recomputed independently. Derivation type input_sha256 compares a quoted literal with the SHA-256 of the named supplied input file. Prospective design, review and authorization hashes quoted in the documents are not inputs to the checker; their bindings are listed in provenance/CLAIM_EVIDENCE.json. A derivation field study selects the record set: '001' (default; PHASE2-MUTABLE-MEMORY-001, 22 records), '002' (PHASE2-PERFORMANCE-CONVERSION-002, 19 records) or 'both' (counts across the two separate accepted estimate sets, which are never pooled). Sources prefixed s2_ are Study 002 records. Derivation type source_ratio formats numerator/denominator from one source; an optional format string wraps the formatted value.
